notes.title: BUGFIX
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone!
Thank you, as always, for playing For The Queen.

We’ve received reports of a bug where launching the DLC “Digital Album” causes leaderboard scores to roll back and be saved incorrectly. We’ve released a patch that fixes this issue.

We sincerely apologize to anyone who experienced inconvenience due to this problem. Thank you for your understanding and continued support!

*

大家好！
感谢大家一直以来对《For The Queen》的支持与喜爱。

我们收到了玩家反馈：在启动 DLC《Digital Album》时，排行榜的分数会被错误地回滚并保存。对此我们已经发布了修复补丁。

对于因此而在游玩过程中带来不便的玩家，我们深表歉意。感谢您的理解与支持！

*

こんにちは！
いつも『For The Queen』をプレイしていただき、誠にありがとうございます。

DLC「Digital Album」を起動すると、ランキングのスコアが以前の状態に巻き戻って保存されるバグが報告されました。この問題については、修正パッチを配信いたしました。

本件によりご不便をおかけしたプレイヤーの皆様には、心よりお詫び申し上げます。ご理解とご協力、誠にありがとうございます。

*

안녕하세요! 
포 더 퀸을 플레이 해주시는 여러분들께 언제나 감사합니다. 

게임 리더 보드가 DLC DigitalAlbum을 켜면 점수를 이 전으로 롤백 시켜 저장하는 버그가 있음을 제보받았습니다. 해당 버그를 수정하는 패치를 진행하였습니다. 

이로 인해 게임을 플레이하는데에 불편을 겪으신 분들이 있다면 사과의 말씀을 전합니다.

notes.title: 👑For the Queen - 50% Off Sale, and a Sequel Coming Soon!👑
notes.notes:
[b]Hello Everyone![/b]
To celebrate the release of the new DLC for ISEKAI FRONTLINE, For the Queen is now on a special sale!

We’re also thrilled to share some exciting news—development for the sequel to For the Queen is currently underway!

The upcoming sequel picks up after one of the game’s specific endings and tells the story of the protagonist, defeated in a war against a newly emerged faction called the Celestial Realm. Tasked by the Queen, the protagonist must confront the leader of the Celestial Realm, the Saintess, and attempt to assassinate her...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43654322/2f2e2acb687466078c07bc9b6153492cb9f49c28.png[/img]

Development is already well underway, with new stories, characters, and content in the works. We’ll be sharing more detailed information very soon!

Look forward to this thrilling new chapter!

notes.title: Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Bug Fixes

Hello everyone! Thank you for your continued interest in the game. The For the Queen team is a small one, so we have a hard time identifying and fixing issues, but it's all thanks to your help that we are able to do so. As always, thank you.

Today's bug fixes center around game freezes after winning battles, some life drain issues, fixes for English translations of achievements, and more... along with patches to help with saber error popups and backups.

If you have any other issues that make the game difficult, please comment on this post and the team will check it out, thanks.

notes.title: Hot Fix!!!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! 

It was discovered that some items in For the Queen had an error in their randomized drop rate in the Training Room. The drop rates for these items have now been corrected.

We apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused. 
As always, thank you for your interest in the game.

notes.title: BUG FIX!
notes.notes:
BUG FIX! 

After the update, we've been receiving reports of bugs with save files, repeated Queen battles, and inaccurate leaderboard rankings, and we've urgently fixed these issues.

If you're still experiencing these or any other issues, please let us know in this thread so we can make the game even better. Thank you!

notes.title: Delayed release
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43654322/e35b128ee33fb1d509fe97978a8b75214e69dd7d.png[/img]


[b]Delayed release [/b]
The DLC release has been postponed to January 19th.


We're so sorry. Due to a miscommunication between the team, we realized that we had the wrong settings for the release.
The DLC is already complete, and we'll be checking the game one more time before the 19th to make sure it's not missing anything, and we'll be back with a more complete version. 

We really appreciate your interest and apologize for the inconvenience. 






[b]发布延期 [/b]

DLC 已推迟至 1 月 19 日发布。

我们非常抱歉。由于制作团队之间的沟通失误，我们发现发布的设置有误。
DLC 已经完成，我们会在 19 日之前再检查一次游戏，确保没有遗漏任何内容，我们会带着更完整的版本回来。

我们非常感谢您的关注，并对由此造成的不便深表歉意。
[b]
発売延期 [/b]






DLCの発売が1月19日に延期されます。

誠に申し訳ございません。制作チーム間のコミュニケーションに誤りがあり、発売に関する設定が間違っていたことが確認されました。
このため、発売日は1月19日に変更となりましたが、すでにDLCは完成している状況であり、19日までにもう一度、ゲームに不足がないかをチェックし、より完璧な状態でお届けできるよう努めてまいります。

皆様のご愛顧に感謝するとともに、ご迷惑をおかけして申し訳ございませんでした。








[b]
Aplazamiento del lanzamiento [/b]

El lanzamiento del DLC se ha pospuesto al 19 de enero.

Lo sentimos mucho. Debido a un error de comunicación entre el equipo de producción, hemos descubierto que los ajustes para el lanzamiento eran incorrectos.
El DLC ya está completo, y revisaremos el juego una vez más antes del 19 para asegurarnos de que no falta nada, y volveremos con una versión más completa. 

Os agradecemos mucho vuestro interés y os pedimos disculpas por las molestias que os hayamos podido causar. 








[b]발매 연기 [/b]

DLC 발매가 1월 19일로 연기됩니다.

정말 죄송합니다. 제작팀 간의 의사 소통에 오류가 있어, 발매에 관련된 설정이 잘못 되어있던 것이 확인되었습니다.
이 때문에 발매일은 1월 19일로 변경되었지만. 이미 DLC는 완성되어 있는 상황이며, 19일 까지 한 번 더 게임에 부족한 것이 없는 지 체크하고 더 완벽한 모습으로 찾아뵙도록 하겠습니다. 

여러분이 보내주시는 관심에 정말 감사하며, 불편을 끼쳐드려 죄송합니다.

notes.title: DLC for For the Queen is coming.
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43654322/cc0dcfde0cdfa3c912c3dad9a5a720c19fc64880.png[/img]


Hello! As always, thank you for your love of For the Queen.

We have some exciting news to share with you.
We're releasing a mini-patch and DLC for For the Queen on January 16th.

The basic patch will focus on user-facing systems, such as a scoreboard for players to compete against each other in the training room and the addition of achievements.

The DLC will include additional heroines, four additional storylines, additional random events, and additional units. 

Stay tuned for more details! 

*

こんにちは！いつもフォーザクイーンをご愛顧いただき、誠にありがとうございます。

皆さんに嬉しいお知らせがあります。
フォー・ザ・クイーンのミニパッチとDLCの発売が1月16日に行われる予定です。

基本パッチは、修練室でユーザー同士でスコアを競うことができるスコアボードやチャレンジ課題の追加など、ユーザーのためのシステムがメインになる予定です。

DLCにはヒロインたちの追加Hシーンと追加ストーリー4種、追加ランダムイベント、追加ユニットが収録される予定です。

ぜひご期待ください！

*

您好！感谢您一直以来对 FounderQueen 的支持。

我们有一些令人兴奋的消息要告诉您。
我们将于 1 月 16 日发布一个小补丁和 DLC。

基本补丁将主要针对玩家系统，例如增加记分板和成就，让玩家在训练室中相互竞争。

DLC 将包括额外的女主角场景、四个额外的故事、额外的随机事件和额外的单位。

更多详情，敬请期待！

*

안녕하세요! 포 더 퀸을 사랑해주시는 여러분께 언제나 감사드립니다.

여러분에게 전할 기쁜 소식이 있습니다.
포 더 퀸의 미니 패치와 DLC 발매가 1월 16일에 이루어질 예정입니다.

기본 패치는 수련실에서 유저끼리의 점수를 겨룰 수 있는 스코어보드와 도전 과제 추가등의 유저를 위한 시스템들이 주가 될 예정이며

DLC에는 히로인들의 추가 H씬과 추가 스토리가 4종, 추가 랜덤 이벤트, 추가 유닛이 수록될 예정입니다. 

많은 관심 부탁드립니다!

notes.title: Small update!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43654322/6017e57d68e1a8d72bc3011dab16554859ca50d6.png[/img]

[b]Small Patch! [/b]


Hello, everyone enjoying the game.
We're listening to your feedback and working to make the game even better. 


This small update focuses on fixing some frustrating bugs.


- Fixed an infinite recovery bug for some units when using certain items.
- Some AI improvements for ranged units.
- Fixed a bug where race buff values for purchased skills were not being applied correctly.
- Fixed an item duplication bug in certain situations
- Fixed being able to check the unit book during battle
- Fixed the ability to skip through H-scene animations step by step.
- Inserted player health damage effect to intuitively recognize when a player loses the game due to health depletion. 
- Fixed some translations 


We're still working on many other things you've pointed out, and we promise to make the game even better. 

Thank you for your interest and support.

notes.title: Small update!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43654322/6017e57d68e1a8d72bc3011dab16554859ca50d6.png[/img]

[b]Small update! [/b]


Hello, everyone who is enjoying the game.
We've been listening to your feedback and working to make the game even better. 

This small update is focused on fixing the infinite loading bug you're currently experiencing, an error in the digital artbook, reducing the difficulty of the Queen battle, and a few other relatively pressing things.
(If you're still experiencing errors after the patch, please let the team know - your reports are very helpful).

We're continuing to work on many of the things you've pointed out, and we promise to make the game even better. 

Thank you for your attention.








*Below is an announcement about the old bug, in case anyone is still experiencing the same issue. 
________________________________




This is a notice about infinite loading for some users.  

We apologize for the inconvenience.
If you played an earlier demo or beta version of For the Queen, the infinite loading may have been caused by an option file issue.

We are currently working on this issue and hope to have it resolved soon. If you're having trouble playing, try the following. 

[u]On Windows, you can resolve this issue by going to Registry Explorer and clearing the HKEY_CURRENT_USER/SOFTWARE/GINKCO file, then running it.
[/u]

If you are still unable to play the game after that, please contact us!
Thank you to all of our players.
